scope: Post-result validation-only correction for the completed v241 formal and independent runs. The Case 7 data, operators, observations, cache sequence, K14 directions, K1 control, metric-specific minima, numerical ranks, exact-call ledgers, accuracy gates, summaries, and all scientific arrays remain immutable.

defect_analysis.reconstructed_k1_field_check: The formal audit reconstructed the first K1 field from the captured K14 direction by dividing the direction by the Jacobi inverse diagonal before rebuilding gamma. That diagnostic floating-point path is not the frozen v237 K1 arithmetic and is not used to form any K14 or K1 metric design. The cache update reads only the copied p1 and A p1 columns. The independent reconstructed K1 field passes the inherited 2e-9 bound, while both implementations reproduce all sealed v240 K1 minima and ranks.
defect_analysis.projected_direction_orthogonality_check: Exact-arithmetic CGLS projected directions are mutually orthogonal, but fourteen finite-precision recurrences need not satisfy a 1e-9 normalized off-diagonal bound. Mutual orthogonality is not required for the tested linear span. Physical validity is instead established by direct A reapplication to the first and fourteenth directions, finite full-rank metric images, exact formal-independent rank agreement, and independent SVD/QR span minima.
defect_analysis.why_no_scientific_gate_changes: Neither failed assertion is a field, gradient, interior-gradient, observation, matched-accuracy, rank, call-ledger, parent-control, nesting, permutation, forward-consistency, adjoint, or formal-independent tolerance. The erratum changes no scientific array or threshold and introduces no candidate selection.

readjudication_rules.required_prior_failure_shape: The formal and first validation false-check sets must match observed_inconclusive exactly, and every other original check must be true.
readjudication_rules.direct_array_checks: Without importing either v241 numerical implementation, re-open only the sealed arrays; verify identity, shape, dtype, finiteness, K14 and K1 formal-independent differences, exact ranks, exact calls, K1-v240 reproduction, K14 nesting, cache audits, and the recorded summaries.
readjudication_rules.summary_recomputation: Independently recompute all 533 cell gates and all 13 complete-rig p90-higher/worst gates from the sealed K14 minima and the sealed v235 K16 reference metrics using the unchanged v241 accuracy contract.
readjudication_rules.diagnostic_handling: Record both finite-precision projected-direction orthogonality values and both reconstructed-K1 field values, but do not use them as scientific validity gates. Require direct A-direction replay, full rank, independent minima, K1-parent, cache, call, permutation, adjoint, and all unchanged scientific gates instead.
readjudication_rules.tree_immutability: The complete formal, first-validation, v240-control, and v235-reference trees used by the readjudicator must remain byte-identical before and after the run.
readjudication_rules.decision_order: Any seal, source, failure-shape, array, rank, call, K1-parent, nesting, cache, direct-replay, summary, or unchanged-tree mismatch remains inconclusive. Only a complete pass may recover the original v241 scientific decision from the independently recomputed summary.

output_contract.interpretation: A pass establishes only post-open necessary metric-wise span capacity for the already opened Case 7 sequence. It does not establish joint coefficients, an observation-only rule, an actual K14 reconstruction, effective exact-call saving, wall/RSS benefit, external generalization, curved rays, or real BOST.
